item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: EdgeBar 1.9
item.description:
macOS Trackpad Edge Controls Brightness Volume

EdgeBar is a menu bar tool for macOS that turns the edges of your MacBook trackpad into volume, screen brightness, and media playback controls. By default, the volume is adjusted by swiping along the right edge, the brightness is adjusted by swiping along the left edge, and the system prompts that are consistent with the keyboard adjustment are displayed; the left and right functions can be swapped as usual. Double-click the top right corner to quickly mute, the bottom media bar supports swiping to cut songs and double-click to play or pause, and you can reverse the direction of the cut song gesture. Provides slight tactile feedback when swiping, supports quarter step adjustment while holding down Shift and Option, and enables fine swiping without the need for a key. The software allows you to adjust the width of the edge, limit the sliding start area to three-quarters, one-half, or one-quarter below the edge, and configure the modifier key requirements to freeze with the cursor to reduce false touches in daily operations. The menu bar panel displays brightness and volume in real time, provides tactile intensity, light and dark appearance, login activation and automatic update settings, and optionally supports Magic Mouse top edge sliding.

item.title: Isle 1.1.10
item.description:
Mac Music Playback Controls

Isle is a Smart Island tool for macOS 26 and above that turns the bangs area on the top of the MacBook into an interactive portal that integrates music control, AI usage viewing, focus timing, file staging, and screenshot annotation. It also supports external monitors and Macs without bangs. The software can display the music, album cover and playback progress being played by the system, display the remaining quota of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and other services through the ring indication, and display the session steps and waiting response status. The shelf keeps a copy of the dragged-in file for seven days and supports AirDrop sending; the screenshot tool provides brush, arrow, text, shape, and pixelation. Users can also enable modules such as system monitoring, peripheral power, clipboard history, meeting entrances, weather, notepads, and shortcuts as needed. The built-in character Islet indicates the completion of tasks, the end of timing, and other events through emoticons and animations. Notifications and characters can be set separately. Music, calendars, clipboards, notes, etc. are handled locally, features such as weather and enabled AI usage queries are networked on demand, and permissions are only requested when required by the relevant module.

item.title: TuneRight 1.0.4
item.description:
macOS Music Metadata Editor

TuneRight is a native music label organizer for macOS that identifies releases by listening to songs and matches existing music files with track names, artists, albums, years, genres, and covers. Users can scan the entire folder to quickly see which songs are complete, which matches have been found, and which still need to be checked without having to open the files one by one for troubleshooting. TuneRight presents suggested tags and covers next to songs, supports group review by album, and allows you to select additional matches, skip processing, or manually edit information for individual songs; editing tags allows you to centrally modify titles, artists, albums, years, and genres, and pick custom covers. Album cover sources include fanart.tv and Cover Art Archive, and missing genres can be supplemented from the Apple Music Store. The scanning process only reads the file, only writes the changes after the user clicks on the application, and can undo the restoration of the song. The software supports MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV and AIFF and does not download, play or share music;

item.title: PicSift 1.0.4
item.description:
Mac Smart AI Natural Language Photo Search

PicSift is a photo scoring and filtering tool for Mac and iPad that evaluates photos in six dimensions: overall look, clarity, light, composition, face, and subject, helping users pick out works worth keeping from traveling, gathering, and daily shooting. The user can drag the priority chart to adjust the weights, or use the technology and art, people and scenes sliders to quickly change the filtering trend, and the photos will be reordered in real time with the settings. The software provides presets for portraits, landscapes, and more, and Smart Auto allows you to adjust the focus of ratings based on the content of each photo. Grid viewing, retention and exclusion tags, keyboard shortcuts, and undo actions are supported while browsing, and excluding photos does not delete the original immediately. The delete tray holds unwanted photos centrally, reviewed, and bulk cleaned; deletions from Apple Photo Gallery go to Recent Deletions and sync to other devices when iCloud Photos is enabled. Natural language visual search, face grouping, similar photo recognition, smart albums, and location maps make it even easier to organize. The photo scoring is done locally on the device, no account is required, and the developer declares that no data is collected, which is suitable for users who value privacy and personalized selection.

item.title: Tinkerwell 5.17.4
item.description:
PHP Interactive Debugging Tool

Tinkerwell is a PHP code execution and debugging tool for macOS that provides an interactive editing environment combined with application context for Laravel developers to quickly validate ideas, troubleshoot problems, and write functional prototypes. It supports multi-line editing, code completion, and instant evaluation, and can directly test functions, controller logic, and Eloquent queries, reducing the operation of temporarily creating routes or controllers for debugging. The software recognizes output types, displays results in expandable cards, searchable tables, and object diagrams, and supports HTML previews of messages and views for easy checking of data, interface responses, and message content. With SSH, you can connect to remote applications to execute PHP code without modifying the code files on the server; the runtime environment also covers Laravel Cloud, Laravel Vapor, Docker, and Kubernetes. Tinkerwell 5 also provides natural language generation code and AI code completion, combined with magic annotations, log tracking, code snippets and command panels to help shorten the feedback cycle in daily development.

item.title: Fantastical 4.2.2
item.description:
macOS Calendar Manager

Fantastical is a professional calendar, reminders, and task management application for macOS that centralizes scheduling, to-do lists, meeting collaboration, and multi-account synchronization into a clear workspace. It supports natural language parsing. Simply enter "Having lunch with colleagues at 1 p.m. on Friday" or "Remind me to buy milk on Tuesday" and it will automatically recognize the date, time, recurrence rules, reminders, and task information and complete the creation. It also supports voice dictation, image extraction, and Apple Intelligence-assisted recognition of complex content. The app provides a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly view, as well as quick viewing and adding of items through a menu bar mini window. Fantastical connects to iCloud, Google, Exchange, Microsoft 365, Todoist, and more to support time zones, weather, calendar sets, templates, travel times, meeting links, invite replies, available time queries, and meeting polls.

item.title: Shapr3D 26.180.0
item.description:
3D Drafting CAD Modeling for macOS

Shapr3D Orpheus is a professional 3D CAD modeling software for macOS that integrates sketching, solid modeling, 2D engineering output and design visualization into one workflow, suitable for product design, mechanical parts development, furniture making and model preparation before manufacturing. The software uses the Siemens Parasolid geometric modeling kernel and the D-Cubed sketch engine to support stretching, rotation, sweeping, lofting, and Boolean operations, while retaining the edability of the design through a parametric workflow. The adaptive interface reduces the operation of the lookup command by recommending tools based on the current selection and modeling scenarios. Users can automatically sync projects between devices such as Mac and iPad, design offline, and model viewing, inspection, and presentation on the iPhone. Visualization tools combine real-time rendering, materials, decals, and augmented reality presentations to share models via links for download-free viewing.

item.title: MyGo 云音乐 0.1.24
item.description:
Mac NetEase Cloud Music 3rd Party Client

MyGo Cloud Music is a third-party desktop client for NetEase Cloud Music developed using Go and the MyGo framework. It features a native interface, requires no WebView, and is suitable for users who want to browse music, manage playlists, and listen to podcasts through a native application. The software supports scanning and logging in, and saves the logged-in state in the system credential store. You can access daily recommendations, recommended song lists, leaderboards, and personal song lists, search for singles, singers, albums, users, and podcasts, and quickly find content with search suggestions and history. For playback, it offers Private FM, Heartbeat Mode, shuffle and loop playback, supports simultaneous downloading and playback, and offers multiple audio quality options from standard to lossless FLAC and Hi-Res. Listened songs are cached on the device. Word-by-word lyrics, lyric translation, rhythm view, and song comments enrich the listening experience. Volume equalization, fade-in/fade-out during pause and resume, and playback progress restoration make daily listening more seamless. Podcast programs can be transcribed into subtitles using the device's speech recognition and displayed scrolling as the audio plays. Users can also enable the mini player at the top of the screen (within the notch) and use it in light, dark, or system-appropriate appearance modes.

item.title: WindowShelf 1.0.132
item.description:
Mac Sidebar Window Manager

WindowShelf is a native macOS window manager designed for users who handle a large number of windows simultaneously. It provides a persistent sidebar interface that allows users to easily switch between windows, group related windows by project, quickly arrange layouts, and maintain a clear workspace overview across different applications, spaces, and multiple monitors. WindowShelf uses a sidebar-first workflow where users can choose to always display the sidebar or trigger the display through the edge, eliminating the need to look for windows or rely on complex shortcuts in the center of the screen. Software supports dragging windows from different applications to a custom shelf, organizing work by project, and restoring the same structure at any time to avoid context loss due to window clutter. Built-in tiling allows users to quickly arrange windows into left and right half screens, corners, center positions, maximization, or category layouts that automatically bypass the sidebar width to ensure a neat layout. WindowShelf also works perfectly with multi-monitor environments based on the screen where the mouse cursor is located or the main display.

item.title: RClick 2.3.2
item.description:
Open Source Access Right-Click Menu Enhancement Tool

RClick is a Finder context menu enhancement app for macOS, based on Swift 6.2 and SwiftUI, for macOS 15.6 and above, with full support for dark mode and adaptive SF Symbols icons. It uses the dual-process architecture of the main application and the FinderSync extension, and communicates through DistributedNotificationCenter to inject custom actions into the Finder right-click menu. Core features include using any installed app to open files or folders and support custom parameters and environment variables, one-click copy full path to the clipboard, direct permanent deletion to bypass the wastebasket, toggling file hiding status, instant sharing via AirDrop, creating new files in iWork format such as txt json md docx pptx xlsx and pages key numbers from preset templates, and fixing frequently used directories to menus for quick access.

item.title: Clash Verge Rev 2.5.9
item.description:
Cross-platform Clash graphics client

Clash Verge Rev/ByWave is a Clash Meta graphical user interface (GUI) software based on Tauri for Windows, MacOS, Linux operating systems. The software focuses on the development and maintenance of the Clash Meta core and no longer includes the Clash core. Key features of Clash Verge include profile management and enhancements (support for yaml and Javascript), an improved user interface and custom theme colors, built-in Clash. Meta (mihomo) core, system proxy setup and protection, etc. In addition, Clash Verge provides a range of advanced features, such as displaying LAN IP information, setting page one-click replication environment variables, optimization of service mode installation logic, support for visual editing of subscription proxy groups, nodes, and rules, and extended scripting support. Removed kernel authorization and changed to service mode implementation, adding features such as autofill local subscription names, significant update processing logic, individually specified extension configuration/scripts for subscriptions, visual rule editor, and new toolbar buttons for editors.

item.title: Kaku 0.28.0
item.description:
AI Intelligent Programming Terminal Tool

Kaku is a macOS terminal emulator built for AI programming based on deeply customized WezTerm to provide an efficient working environment out of the box while preserving Lua configuration capabilities and API compatibility. The software uses JetBrains Mono fonts, font rendering for macOS, and low-resolution font size settings to automatically switch between dark and light color modes, and optimize the selection color, font weight, and interface color matching. Built-in zsh plugin and optional command-line tools to override common processes such as prompts, differential viewing, file navigation, etc. After symbol cropping, feature reduction, resource lazy loading, and GPU acceleration, it has a smaller program size, faster startup speed, and lower resource consumption. Kaku also integrates an AI assistant that generates fix suggestions when commands fail, converts natural language descriptions into terminal commands to be confirmed, and supports tool configurations such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Kimi Code.

item.title: OnlySwitch release_3.4.0
item.description:
Menu Bar System Switches Collection

OnlySwitch is a powerful macOS menu bar application that provides a series of switches designed to simplify the user's daily workflow, such as hiding desktop icons, switching dark mode, and hiding the grooves of the new MacBook Pro. The user can easily control these functions in the status bar, and the displayed switches and shortcuts can be customized as needed. Since version 1. As of 7, users can import custom shortcuts into OnlySwitch and support keyboard shortcuts from version 2.0. The app also supports Apple widgets, which allow users to place relevant switches and buttons on their desktops or notification centers for quick and easy access. OnlySwitch supports switching between various macOS browsers, keeping users' browsing history and allowing users to add or remove features based on their needs. The software comes with a 30-day free trial and can be installed via Homebrew or downloaded manually. OnlySwitch is a powerful menu bar app designed to streamline users' daily workflows, such as hiding desktop icons, switching between dark modes, and hiding the bangs of the new MacBook Pro.

item.title: FanBar 0.8.0
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: Motrix 2.2.1
item.description:
Multi-Protocol Resource Download Tool

Motrix for Mac is an all-around download tool. Support HTTP download, FTP download, BT download, magnetic link download, Baidu net disk resource download. Motrix also uses "Aria 2" as the core, so the download speed, multi-threading and other capabilities are almost the same as other download tools.

item.title: LuLu 4.5.7
item.description:
Open-source lightweight firewall for macOS

LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections until you explicitly approve them. It detects and stops unauthorized network connections, helping prevent malware and third-party apps from sending data to remote servers. Its design is simple and easy to use, with a small attack surface, and its source code is public on GitHub for transparency. It supports single-user installs and currently focuses on process-level network rules. It provides basic network monitoring rather than full self-protection, so determined targeted attacks may still bypass it.

item.title: PeakHour 6.2.2
item.description:
macOS Menu Bar Network Traffic Monitor

PeakHour: Internet Monitor is a real-time network monitoring tool for macOS that centralizes bandwidth, latency, wireless signals, and connection health to troubleshoot video conferencing issues, slow downloads, network outages, and poor broadband performance. The software displays Mac, router, and carrier-to-Internet connectivity paths through menu bars and visual dashboards, helps determine where performance bottlenecks lie, and enables monitoring of UPnP or SNMP-capable routers, switches, and NAS. Built-in speed measurement combines download speed, upload speed, and rpm responsiveness ratings, and you can also see actual performance against your broadband plan. Wi-Fi analytics identifies weak signals and distractions, while historical charts make it easy to look back at traffic, delays, congestion, and disconnections. Apple Intelligence-based network consultants can rate connections, explain questions and advise in plain English, and require a Mac that supports that capability.

item.title: SubManager 2.1.1
item.description:
Subscription Tracking Expiration Reminder Assistant

SubManager is an app designed to help users centrally manage their subscriptions, enabling them to track all their subscriptions in one place. Developed using the latest technology and designed with a user interface for Apple devices that allows users to be notified in advance of subscription renewals, the app has become especially important in managing subscriptions as subscription services continue to grow. SubManager features include support for an unlimited number of subscriptions, 90-day advance notice, conversion of foreign currency subscriptions to local currency, subscription-based insights, iCloud sync, home and lock screen widgets, Siri shortcuts, comprehensive Apple Watch support, and an ad-free web app that can view iCloud data on any device. Further enhancements SubManager + is a one-time purchase that can be used on all Apple devices, and features available on iOS include classification, payment methods, price history, additional information in insights, expired subscription archives, expiration notifications, storing lifetime subscriptions, app locks, exporting and importing in JSON/CSV format, and changing the app icon to a local currency logo on an iPhone or iPad.

item.title: Typeface 4.5.2
item.description:
Professional font manager

Typeface is a beautiful font manager that helps you choose the right fonts for your designs. It organizes your font library with flexible tags and improves your workflow with live font previews. The new version adds detailed metadata lists, custom sorting and partial font families, supports many font formats, and can import Adobe fonts and manage font collections. The PRO version unlocks character overviews, OpenType feature inspection and dynamic previews.

item.title: Remixlive 8.7.1
item.description:
Mac Music Maker

Remixlive, the ideal beat production and live performance app for producers and DJs, adds automation to make it easy for users to record and play back dynamic changes to mixers, filters, equalizers, and effects, creating vibrant mixes. Supporting up to 48 cycles of simultaneous playback, the app allows users to change keys and BPM in real time, improvise and record drums and instruments, shape and reshape sounds in real time with professional-grade effects, create their own sequences and patterns, and arrange sounds on a timeline to complete songs. Remixlive offers more than 32,000 professional-grade samples, spanning more than 20 music genres, crafted by top sound designers and world-class artists, that have been copyright cleared for personal and commercial use. Remixlive has advanced professional-level features, including a professional audio engine and sample time stretching, support for importing your own samples, connecting any MIDI controller, mixing any song with AI Stem separation algorithms, and recording and sampling any audio source. Remixlive also supports real-time co-creation with friends via Ableton Link.

item.title: FocusFlight(专注飞机) 2.1
item.description:
Aviation Theme Focus on Timing

FocusFlight – Deepfocus Timer is a unique application designed to help users improve their focus and productivity, combining the thrill of aviation with the challenge of concentration to provide users with a new experience. The app allows users to book a custom centralized flight at any time, setting the duration and type of focus, making each focus a ritual-like journey. Users can activate "Airplane Mode", enter a distraction-free environment, and help stay focused by automatically blocking interfering apps through screen time integration with Apple. FocusFlight also provides tagging capabilities and focus data tracking to visualize focus habits and progress, and customize task types such as learning, working, or reading with different seating options to make focus flexible and fun. In addition, users can turn their focus time into completed virtual routes, unlock new cities, create personalized flight maps, and set customized habit-based reminders to stay productive and focused. FocusFlight was conceived from the development team's deep understanding of the challenges of ADHD and their love of aviation, allowing users to control their focus as if they were navigating a flight path.

item.title: TrellisWM 0.10.0
item.description:
macOS Window Organizer

TrellisWM is a native window management tool for Macs on Apple chips that runs on macOS 14 Sonoma and later to reorganize real-world application windows with nested spaces and scalable desktop views. Users can drag windows to other windows or to the edge of the screen for docking, zoom between multiple levels of space for browsing, or use trackpad gestures or shortcuts to quickly see all windows, enter a higher level space, focus on the current window, and switch adjacent areas. The software supports dragging the separator line to synchronously resize the window. When the window is minimized, the adjacent window will automatically fill the space, and it will still return to its original position when restored. The layout can be saved separately according to the display. The Pro version provides unlimited docking windows, cross-app tab sets, save views, URL commands, and support for future versions of Windows; the free version retains core features such as docking, nesting, zoom, live preview, and keyboard navigation.

item.title: Nexus Shell 1.8.1
item.description:
macOS Native Docker Container SSH Management Tool

Nexus Shell is a macOS native SSH client based on SwiftUI that provides an all-in-one workbench for server operators and developers. Software integrated terminal access, SFTP file management, Docker container operation, SSH key generation and management, and real-time server monitoring. Users can quickly manage multiple connections in the main interface, support favorites and real-time status display, and click the host to view the CPU, memory, network load, process information and system specifications. The terminal interface has a built-in AI assistant that can generate commands, diagnose errors, and summarize output. You need to configure the API Key yourself. The file browser supports directory browsing, permission viewing, and file transfer, and the Docker panel can monitor the status of containers, resource occupation, and start and stop operations in real time. Nexus Shell uses local encrypted storage private keys and configurations to ensure data security. It supports macOS 14.0 and above systems. Apple Silicon is natively optimized, the interface is simple and smooth, and the operation is efficient. It is suitable for daily use by individual developers and professional operation and maintenance teams.

item.title: ExtraBar 1.7.5
item.description:
Customize your menu bar personalization

ExtraBar is a menu bar management tool customized for Mac users that provides instant access to applications, deep links, and custom actions without any permissions. It enables users to create personalized actions to better align with their workflows. Unlike traditional macOS menu bars, ExtraBar allows users to configure flexibly according to their needs, getting rid of fixed icons and limited functionality. Users can customize shortcuts for careers such as designing, developing, or managing, and organize frequently used files and applications in an intuitive management interface. ExtraBar supports deep links that take you directly where you need to go to make your work more efficient. ExtraBar does not require system-level permissions, and users can simply download and add apps to use it. A one-time lifetime access offer is also now available for a first-time purchase of 9. €99 for all features and future updates. ExtraBar is committed to making your menu bar as personal and efficient as the way you work.

item.title: Widgetscape 1.4.4
item.description:
macOS Native Desktop Widget

Widgetscape is a native desktop widget tool for macOS that provides 31 widgets covering time, efficiency, system monitoring, and life information to bring schedules, weather, music playback, hardware status, and development activities directly to the desktop. The software adopts a unified grid layout and supports eight sizes. Each size has an independently designed content layout. It automatically absorbs and aligns when dragging, and can also be placed freely. The user can adjust the appearance through 23 sets of color schemes, light and dark modes, and four surface styles: glass, solid color, stroke, and transparent, and set the position for different monitors and desktop spaces. Featured features include a Day Timeline that displays the schedule along the edge of the screen, Token Pulse that reads the logs of local AI programming tools, and Repo Pulse that looks at Git branches and changes. The Playing component supports media information and playback controls for Music, Spotify, Safari, and Chrome. The software is developed using Swift, does not rely on web view, redraws only when the content changes, and the invisible components stop working.

item.title: CoolDock 2.2.2
item.description:
Mac Dock Enhancement Tool

CoolDock is an intelligent second Dock tool for macOS Sonoma and higher, which does not replace the original Dock of the system, but provides a separate docking bar next to it that can carry real-time components, shortcuts, application entrances, and daily information. Users can centralize music playback, weather, calendar events, reminders, to-dos, pomodoros, system status, searches, clipboards, screenshots, file shelves, download directories, quick switches, and more in one beautiful dynamic dock, reducing the frequency of switching between multiple apps. The software emphasizes local and privacy priorities, and only requests permissions such as calendars, reminders, photos, microphones, accessibility, or automation when required by the relevant features. It also supports app and folder fixing, multiple Dock configurations, floating layouts, resizing and appearance adjustments, wallpaper decoration, and modern Mac workflows with external displays, allowing users to build a more efficient and personalized desktop action center according to their own habits.

item.title: Cork 2.1.2
item.description:
Homebrew GUI Manager

Cork is the ultimate graphical user interface (GUI) for Homebrew, a fast interface written in its SwiftUI that lets you easily install and manage packages without the need for a terminal. Not only does Cork intelligently find and install Formulae and Casks, it also allows you to add any Tap to access more packages, while providing maintenance features like cleaning cache, uninstalling packages, and more to keep your Mac neat and tidy. It also packs all the details of the bag and Tap in one place and supports multiple languages, ensuring ease of use for users around the world. Cork focuses on the user experience, making it easy to get started, even for users who are not familiar with the technology. It uses minimal system resources and is optimized with the most modern technologies to ensure a fast and lightweight operating experience. As a free and open source software, Cork is constantly receiving feedback from the community to improve and ensure that it is always in active development. Cork is committed to providing the best experience for Homebrew users in terms of design, functionality, and performance, and its lovely logo adds a touch of familiarity to the software. Add any source: expand your horizons.

item.title: SpaceJump 3.0.2
item.description:
macOS Multi-Desk Space Manager

SpaceJump is a productivity tool created for the macOS Spaces desktop space to solve the problem that the system can only display "Desktop 1, Desktop 2, Desktop 3" for a long time and it is difficult to identify the workspace. It allows users to set names, icons, and colors for each Space, and display these custom names in the menu bar, Mission Control, and Quick Switcher, so that work, writing, music, code, design, research, and other scenarios can be clearly partitioned. Users can call up Quick Switcher through shortcuts, enter keywords to quickly jump to the target space after filtering, or return to the previous position with one click. The software also supports dragging windows to different spaces, adding notes and lists to spaces, setting independent hotkeys, configuring click automation, and providing session time tracking, idle detection, and CSV export by space and application statistics. Developed in native Swift, it is lightweight and suitable for multi-monitor users, developers, designers, freelancers, students, and remote workers managing complex desktop workflows.

item.title: DiskFox 1.3.4
item.description:
Disk space analysis for macOS

DiskFox is a disk space analyzer and storage change tracker for macOS. It builds a scan baseline and compares scans over time to show what is using space, when it grew and why. It recognizes more than 60 kinds of storage that tend to pile up, including Apple Intelligence models, Xcode data, simulator runtimes, device backups, Docker disk images, app caches and Time Machine local snapshots, and it separates measured results from guessed causes. You can review large files, app usage and exact duplicates, see the impact and expected space recovered, then confirm; most selected files go to the Trash and nothing is cleaned automatically. Scans read only file sizes, dates and locations, duplicate checks run locally, nothing is uploaded, and no account is needed.

item.title: Applight 1.1.5
item.description:
Window Smart Switching App

Applight is a revolutionary next-generation app switching tool designed to optimize the user's app switching experience through context-awareness and streamline operations by predicting the next app that might be used. In daily use of the computer, application switching is a frequent task, but existing methods such as using Dock, Command-Tab shortcuts or Spotlight search are often limited and cannot fully consider the context of the user's application switching. Based on this motivation, Applight was born, which realized smarter application prediction by analyzing users' usage habits. Simply press the user-selected modifier key, and Applight will show you a list of apps that might need to be used in the current context, with the most recently used apps appearing at the top of the list so that the user can return instantly with a click. The user can quickly select the target application by entering one or two letters or pressing the number key, and immediately open the selected application by releasing the modifier key. In addition, if the user prefers to use the cursor for app switching, Applight also provides corresponding suggestions.

item.title: ReadKit 4.0.2
item.description:
Powerful RSS Reading App for Mac

ReadKit is a powerful cross-platform reading center application for macOS and iOS. It integrates post-reading, RSS feeds and news aggregation. It supports mainstream RSS services such as Feedly, Inoreader, Feedbin, and post-reading services such as Instapaper and Wallabag. It also has a built-in RSS engine, allowing users to directly subscribe to and manage massive news feeds without additional subscriptions. ReadKit provides multi-account unified management, intelligent folder automatic classification, full-text extraction reading mode, offline cache reading, gesture shortcuts, built-in browser browsing links, automatic background synchronization, sharing extensions to quickly save Safari articles, etc. The interface supports custom themes, light dark mode and application icon switching. Keyboard operation optimization is perfect for Mac hardware keyboard. Users can achieve advanced content filtering through smart folder rules, automatically mark read or starred, easily manage mass articles in combination with powerful search and filtering systems, YouTube channels and playlists can also be subscribed through RSS, and OPML file import and export makes migrating subscriptions easy.

item.title: BetterMouse 1.7
item.description:
macOS Mouse Enhancer

BetterMouse is a utility designed for macOS to improve the performance and functionality of external mice. It is a lightweight, efficiency-optimized tool designed to replace resource-intensive mouse drivers such as Logitech Options. It provides an ultra-smooth scrolling effect, and users can fully configure parameters such as scrolling time, direction, and acceleration. It also provides precisely configured discrete scrolling that enables or disables shift-scrolling to the horizontal direction and can be translated via any button for free scrolling similar to a trackpad. BetterMouse also provides independent cursor acceleration and speed controls that completely eliminate acceleration, as well as accurate mouse frame rate counters. Users can map each additional button click/drag/long press to any keyboard shortcut and a large number of special actions. Each application has its own scroll settings and button/gesture mapping settings. BetterMouse is a secure and clean menu bar application that requires no custom network access, no file access, no extensions, drivers, daemons or agents, and minimal CPU and power usage.
